summary: The article accurately reports Broadcom's Q3 FY2026 financial results, including revenue, EPS, AI semiconductor revenue, cash flow, and dividend, aligning with official press releases and financial news outlets.

claims.claim: Broadcom reported total revenue of $29.6 billion, comfortably surpassing the analyst consensus estimate of approximately $29.519 billion. This represents an impressive 86% year-over-year increase in consolidated revenue.
claims.note: Broadcom's press release confirms Q3 FY2026 revenue of $29.6 billion, up 86% from the prior year period.

claims.claim: Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) also exceeded expectations, coming in at $3.32 against an estimated $3.25.
claims.note: Broadcom's press release states non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.32 for Q3 FY2026.

claims.claim: The company reported a substantial $16.7 billion in AI semiconductor revenue, significantly outperforming its own guidance of $16 billion. This figure marks an extraordinary 221% year-over-year growth and a 54% quarter-over-quarter increase in AI semiconductor revenue.
claims.note: Broadcom's press release confirms Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion, which grew 221% year-over-year and 54% quarter-over-quarter.

claims.claim: The cash flow generation was particularly impressive, with $14.2 billion in cash from operations. After accounting for $0.5 billion in capital expenditures, Broadcom reported a robust $13.7 billion in free cash flow for the quarter.
claims.note: Broadcom's press release states $14.2 billion in cash from operations and $0.5 billion in capital expenditures, resulting in $13.7 billion of free cash flow.

claims.claim: In terms of shareholder returns, Broadcom's Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.65 per share. This dividend is payable on September 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 21, 2026.
claims.note: Broadcom's press release confirms a quarterly cash dividend of $0.65 per share, payable on September 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 21, 2026.

claims.claim: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO) announced robust financial results for its third quarter of fiscal year 2026, ending August 2, 2026
claims.note: Broadcom's press release states that financial results for its third quarter of fiscal year 2026 ended August 2, 2026.
